title: Grade Your Pay Per Call Recordings (Free)
h1: How to grade a pay per call recording in minutes
description: Score your call recordings on greeting, qualifying, objections and the close with a free tool that transcribes and grades calls in your browser.
faq: How can I grade a call recording for free?

Use Call X-Ray. Upload the recording and it transcribes the call and scores it on greeting, qualifying, objection handling, disclosures and the close, then lists specific fixes. It runs entirely in your browser, so the recording is never uploaded.

What makes a pay per call recording score well?

A clear greeting, the qualifying questions the buyer requires, a real answer to the caller's objection, any disclosures your vertical needs, and a clear transfer or next step at the end. Short calls that skip qualifying or the close tend to score poorly and miss the buyer's billable minimum.
body:
In pay per call you get paid on billable calls, and whether a call bills usually comes down to how it was handled: did the agent greet the caller, qualify them properly, handle the objection, and move them to the next step? The fastest way to raise your billable rate is to listen to your own calls and fix the pattern — but listening to every call by hand does not scale. Here is a quicker way.

Grade a recording in your browser, free

Insight Dial has a free tool called Call X-Ray. Upload a call recording (MP3, WAV, M4A) and it writes out the transcript and grades the call against a scorecard, then tells you exactly what to fix. It runs entirely in your browser, so the recording never leaves your device and nothing is uploaded. You can also paste a transcript if you already have one.

The scorecard it checks

  • Greeting and branding — does the call open by greeting the caller and naming the service?
  • Qualifying questions — are the buyer's screening questions actually asked?
  • Objection handling — when the caller pushes back, does the agent keep the conversation going?
  • Required disclosures — is the wording your vertical expects present?
  • A clear close — does the call end with a transfer or a clear next step?
  • Call substance — is there enough conversation to qualify and connect, rather than a quick drop?

Each item is marked pass, needs work or missing, you get an overall grade, and you can download the report to share with an agent or affiliate.

Turn one graded call into better calls

Grade a handful of calls and the weak spots repeat: the same missing disclosure, the same abrupt close, the same source sending short calls. Fix the script once — the IVR and whisper script generator can help — and coach to it. As your calls get cleaner, more of them cross the buyer's billable threshold.

Or grade every call automatically

Doing this by hand is fine for spot checks, but at volume you want it automatic. Inside Insight Dial every call is recorded, transcribed and scored for you, with quality grades per affiliate and buyer and automatic pausing of sources that send poor calls. See the platform features, or try the other free tools for pay per call.
